capabilities: Share chosen folders with the Renor service for agent recall
Live-sync note edits, renames and deletions to Renor
Pull agent-saved memories into the vault as notes in the Renor folder
Ask Renor from the command palette and insert the answer into the current note
Configure shared and private folders via a renor.json file or Settings
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or later (secret storage). Not yet in the community-plugins listing, so it is installed unpacked. API key is stored in Obsidian's secret storage, not data.json; server must be https except localhost. Self-hosted Renor setups do not need the plugin. No telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to expose selected folders as recallable memory for external AI agents or to receive what those agents save back as notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses Renor's existing import tools over MCP. It does not have an importer of its own.
renor sync in the setup CLI (PR #786) is the command-line path to the same tools

summary: Service connector that shares chosen vault folders with AI agents as memory, syncs edits live, pulls agent-saved notes, and answers questions from memory.
